Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sanjay Dhar, Judge.

. The petitioners have challenged the award passed by the Collector land Acquisition (ACR)
Budgam on 06.11.2023, whereby the compensation in respect of the land owned and possessed by the petitioners has been awarded.

02. It is contended by the learned counsel for the petitioners that the declaration under Section 6 of the Jammu and Kashmir Land Acquisition Act was issued in the instant case after the repeal of the said Act and after extension of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, to this part of the Country, as such the impugned award is non-est in the eyes of law.
03.
